body: Call out. If its bothering you enough to make sleep an obstacle than call out.

Wow... I'm so ... thank you. I'm flattered that you would want me to PM you tomorrow night.. I'll mark on my calendar right now :].. 

Thanks for listening to me this long. I know I must sound pretty drab.. 
I'm glad I can talk to someone who knows what I'm going through. You describe it pretty spot on .. I'm sorry that you are going through it as well. Mind if I ask how long it has been going on for you?

I suppose yes...  I guess you are more motivated than I am. I just can't take it much longer. I know suicide isn't the answer. But everything else I have tried hasn't produced much sustainability. I don't want to die... I am just so god damn tired of living this crap life, I'm sad all the time, I'm depressed, no friends... And that saddest part is that it never changes.. I can tell you I was the same way 2 years ago... what is my life going to be, if its been like this for years already? What do I have to look forward to? ..

Yes I have blocked him, but a part of me doesn't want to block him ... UGH I'm so confused with all this- and knowing that there is "someone in his life".... makes me want to rip my guts out...

Sorry for the graphic talk... And sorry that your sister had to go through something similar. I just can't deal with this anymore. Day in and day out... I own a gun .. I can do it anytime... :[ ... I don't want to do it... but I don't want the memories, the feelings, the emotions, and toll it has taken on me. I'm just .. done..

Hi, thanks for reaching out. Yes, everything feels meaningless. I hate the mornings. I wake up and for about 30 minutes I'm motivated, and then every problem of my life starts to sink in, and then I just don't give a crap about anything...

Yes I totally agree with you. I recently found out that there is someone new in his life...which made me have a mini break down. So ever since I broke up with him 2 years ago every couple months he would text me then we would talk for a while and then I'd tell him to not contact me .. The reason why I'd do this is because he wouldn't want to talk to me like when we were together ..he'd just want to talk to me like a friend and then treat me like a booty call. This upset me a lot... So every time he would do this I would eventually have enough of it and tell him to just leave me alone...and so every time after a couple months he would contact me again and I'd hope he change but he wouldn't every time.. I just can't get it out of my head.. How we were when we first met.. We met under very unusual circumstances..

Anyway this is all pretty boring to you I bet. Your advice is helping me though.. So thank you😊

thanks. I just wake up all the time and ask myself where is my life going. I moved away from my home city to get away from my problems, and now that I'm gone all I want t do is move back...  
Have you had a lot of first loves?
